query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `calculationResults` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `projectId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `calculatorType` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `rulesetVersion` varchar(50),
  `inputData` text NOT NULL,
  `resultData` text NOT NULL,
  `calculationTrace` text,
  `cryptographicSignature` text,
  `certificateChain` text,
  `signatureVerified` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `createdBy` varchar(255),
  `ipAddress` varchar(45),
  `userAgent` text,
  `immutable` boolean DEFAULT true,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
